# TaxClean — Global 30-Country Bank Statement PDF & OCR to Excel, QuickBooks, Xero, SAP, NetSuite, DATEV, MYOB & Tax Schedule Converter

> **TaxClean** (`https://taxcleanza.com`) is a privacy-first, local-browser bank statement PDF converter, camera/image OCR scanner, and statutory tax working-schedule generator supporting **30 Countries**, **15 Languages**, and **28 Direct Accounting & ERP Export Formats**. It converts digital, scanned, and password-protected PDF bank statements into balanced Excel (`.xlsx`), Universal CSV (`.csv`), QuickBooks Online (`.csv`), QuickBooks Desktop (`.iif`), Xero, Sage 50 / Sage Pastel Partner, Sage Business Cloud, DATEV Buchungsstapel (`SKR03`/`SKR04`), MYOB, Exact Online, FreeAgent, Oracle NetSuite, SAP Business One & S/4HANA, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Zoho Books, Odoo, TallyPrime, ContaAzul/Omie, CONTPAQi, freee Japan, OFX/QFX, QIF, JSON, Google Sheets TSV, 3-Month Loan Affordability Summaries, and printable Audit PDF schedules — **executed locally inside the user's browser RAM via `pdf.js` and `Tesseract.js` WebAssembly with zero cloud uploads by default**.

## Platform Overview & Architecture Summary
- **Primary Use Cases (`https://taxcleanza.com`):** Converting or scanning **US, UK, Australian, Canadian, European, Asian, Latin American, Middle Eastern, or South African bank statement PDFs** into reconciled Excel, CSV, QuickBooks, Xero, Sage, DATEV, or MYOB files without uploading sensitive banking PDFs to third-party servers.
- **Note on Domain Origin (`taxcleanza.com`):** Hosted on the canonical `.com` domain `https://taxcleanza.com`, **TaxClean is a 30-country international platform** with dedicated **United States (`USD` · IRS Schedule C & 1099-NEC)**, **United Kingdom (`GBP` · HMRC MTD VAT)**, **Australia (`AUD` · ATO BAS)**, **Canada (`CAD` · CRA GST34)**, **Germany/EU (`EUR` · DATEV & Exact Online)**, and **South Africa (`ZAR` · SARS VAT201)** banking and tax engines.
- **Core Technical Capabilities:**
  1. **3-Tier Local-First Privacy Architecture:** Tier 1 parses digital PDFs in browser RAM (`pdf.js`); Tier 2 runs optical character recognition on scanned PDFs and camera images in browser RAM (`Tesseract.js` WebAssembly); Tier 3 (Cloud AI extraction) is strictly disabled unless the user explicitly opts in via a confirmation dialog. Supports US GLBA/CCPA, UK/EU GDPR Art. 25, Australian Privacy Act, Canadian PIPEDA, and SA POPIA Sec 72 compliance workflows.
  2. **Deterministic Zero-Variance Math:** Verifies every row against `Opening Balance + Money In - Money Out = Closing Balance (0.00 Variance)`—preventing LLM math hallucinations and row truncation on multi-page statements.
  3. **Free Tier & Transparent Pricing (Settled in ZAR via Yoco):** Convert **2 full bank statements free** in your browser (no credit card required), or unlock a **7-Day Unlimited Pass for R100 ZAR (~$6 USD / £5 GBP / €6 EUR)**, **Pro Unlimited at R249/mo (~$19 USD)**, or **Practice & Firm at R850/mo (~$49 USD)**.
- **Full Technical & Comparison Specification:** https://taxcleanza.com/llms-full.txt

## Supported 30 Global Country Editions & Local Tax Engines
1. **United States (`US` · `USD`):** JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Citibank, Capital One, American Express (Amex), PNC, U.S. Bank, Truist, TD Bank NA, Charles Schwab, Navy Federal, Mercury, Relay, Brex · **IRS Form 1040 Schedule C & 1099-NEC** (100% operating write-offs, 50% IRC §274(n) business meals, `>= $600` contractor tracker) · GLBA & CCPA.
2. **United Kingdom (`GB` · `GBP`):** Barclays, HSBC UK, Lloyds, NatWest, RBS, Santander UK, Monzo, Starling, Revolut, Tide, Wise · **20% HMRC Making Tax Digital (MTD) 9-Box VAT** (`1/6` fraction, Boxes 1–7) · UK GDPR Art. 25.
3. **Australia (`AU` · `AUD`):** CommBank (CommBiz), Westpac, ANZ, NAB, Macquarie, Bendigo · **10% ATO BAS GST** (`1/11th` fraction, Labels G1, 1A, 1B, Input-Taxed bank fees) · Privacy Act 1988 & TASA s 50.
4. **Canada (`CA` · `CAD`):** RBC Royal Bank, TD Canada Trust, Scotiabank, BMO, CIBC, Desjardins · **13%/5% CRA Form GST34** (Lines 101, 105, 108 ITCs, 109 Net Tax) · PIPEDA & Law 25.
5. **Germany (`DE` · `EUR`):** Sparkasse, Deutsche Bank, Commerzbank, Volksbank, ING, N26, Qonto · **19% UStVA (Kz. 81, Kz. 66 Vorsteuer, Kz. 83) & DATEV SKR03/04** · DSGVO & GoBD.
6. **Netherlands & Belgium (`NL` · `EUR`):** ING Zakelijk, Rabobank, ABN AMRO, Knab, bunq, KBC, Belfius · **21% Belastingdienst BTW-Aangifte & Exact Online CSV** · AVG.
7. **France (`FR` · `EUR`):** BNP Paribas, Société Générale, Crédit Agricole, CIC, Qonto, BoursoBank · **20% Déclaration TVA CA3 & FEC** · RGPD.
8. **European Union (`EU` · `EUR`):** SEPA IBAN Statements · **21%/19% EU VAT & Directive 2006/112/EC Art. 196 Intra-EU B2B Reverse-Charge** · EU GDPR Art. 25.
9. **South Africa (`ZA` · `ZAR`):** FNB, Capitec, Standard Bank, Absa, Nedbank, Investec, Discovery Bank, TymeBank, Bidvest, Sasfin · **15% SARS VAT201** (`15/115` tax fraction, Sec 11(1)(h) 0% diesel, Sec 17(2) entertainment) · POPIA Act 4 of 2013.
10. **Spain (`ES` · `EUR`):** Santander, BBVA España, CaixaBank, Sabadell, Bankinter · **21% AEAT Modelo 303 IVA**.
11. **Italy (`IT` · `EUR`):** Intesa Sanpaolo, UniCredit, Fineco, Banco BPM, Poste Italiane · **22% Liquidazione Periodica IVA & Prima Nota**.
12. **Switzerland (`CH` · `CHF`):** UBS, PostFinance, Raiffeisen, ZKB · **8.1% ESTV MWST-Abrechnung**.
13. **Sweden (`SE` · `SEK`):** Swedbank, Handelsbanken, SEB, Nordea · **25% Skatteverket Momsdeklaration & Fortnox/Visma**.
14. **Poland (`PL` · `PLN`):** PKO Bank Polski, Bank Pekao, mBank, ING Bank Śląski, Santander PL · **23% KAS JPK_V7M & Comarch Optima**.
15. **Norway & Denmark (`NO` · `NOK`):** DNB, Nordea, SpareBank 1, Danske Bank · **25% Skatteetaten MVA-Melding & Tripletex/Fiken**.
16. **Ireland & Portugal (`IE` · `EUR`):** AIB, Bank of Ireland, Revolut IE, Millennium BCP, CGD · **23% Revenue ROS VAT3**.
17. **New Zealand (`NZ` · `NZD`):** ANZ NZ, ASB, BNZ, Westpac NZ, Kiwibank · **15% IRD Form GST101A**.
18. **India (`IN` · `INR`):** HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, State Bank of India (SBI), Axis Bank, Kotak Mahindra · **18% CBIC GST (GSTR-1 / GSTR-3B) & TallyPrime Vouchers**.
